text:
[Council File 26-1380]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ORDINANCE SECOND CONSIDERATION relative to amending Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC) Section 4.61. Schedule "A" to provide a salary adjustment for the Executive Director, City Ethics Commission (Class Code 0013).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated September 11, 2026, approved as to form and legality by the City Attorney, amending Schedule “A” of Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 4.61, to provide a salary adjustment for the Executive Director, City Ethics Commission (Class Code 0013), as approved by the City Ethics Commission.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted [Council adopted Personnel and Hiring Committee report dated October 28, 2026 at the Council meeting of November 6, 2026]
